title: Character skills, Easter Eggs and more
items: Character skills are back in the original My stats tiles: 3 columns, wiki skill icons, the in-game order, saved on this device.
New Character tab: all 29 skill levels, total and combat level, progress to 99 and 120, in one place. Your saved levels carry over.
Items now has an Items | Sets switch: full armour sets that follow your class, tier, slot and 'wearable with my stats' filters, with piece pictures, requirements and prices.
Slot filter tidied: no empty gaps, and empty slots hide behind a toggle.
'What can I do now' shortcuts jump to gear, training, money making and quests that fit your levels.
The Secrets tab is now Easter Eggs, with the wiki's Easter egg icon. Old links still work.
